title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 4
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q031_priceless
elements.title: The archive held a ___ manuscript that could never be replaced.

elements.name: q032_burglary
elements.title: Someone broke into the shop overnight and stole the cash. Which word describes this?

elements.name: q033_race_against_time
elements.title: What does the deadline metaphor mean in “We're in a race against time to finish”?
choices: The easiest task is already complete.
Several people are tied for first.
Nobody knows when work will start.
There is very little time left.
elements.correctAnswer: There is very little time left.

elements.name: q034_historic_dawn
elements.title: The launch marked the ___ of a new era in public transport.

elements.name: q035_one_thing_ends_another_begins
elements.title: Which expression suggests that a fresh opportunity follows a conclusion?
choices: The early bird catches the worm.
Two wrongs don't make a right.

elements.name: q036_the_easy_part
elements.title: Booking the venue was ___; paying for the event will be much harder.

elements.name: q037_surpass
elements.title: To set a record, she needed to ___ the previous fastest time by running even faster.

elements.name: q038_primary_source
elements.title: If a farm gets most of its water from a single well, that well is its ___ of water.

elements.name: q039_demand
elements.title: When the game sold out within minutes, the shop ordered more copies to meet ___.

elements.name: q040_stamp_out
elements.title: The school introduced tougher measures to ___ bullying entirely.
